sentences.text:
This petition under section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner for correction of crime No.
954/2023 wrongly mentioned in the order dated 01/02/2024 passed by this Court in M.Cr.C.No.
2260/2024.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that crime No. 594/2023 was registered at police station Dehat, District Bhind against the petitioner for the offence punishable under section 420, 467, 468 of IPC.
The petitioner was arrested and sent to jail.
Thereafter, he filed an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. bearing M.Cr.C. No. 2260/2024 before this Court which was decided on 01/02/2024.
It is further submitted that in the order dated 01/02/2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No. 2260/2024 crime number has been wrongly mentioned as 954/2023, whereas, it ought to be crime No. 594/2023.

Therefore, it is prayed that the instant petition may kindly be allowed and wrongly mentioned crime No. 954/2023 may directed to be read as correct crime No. 594/2023 and rest of the order dated 01/02/2024 shall be kept intact.

Learned counsel for the respondent / complainant by filing document No. 3374/2024 has submitted that the petitioner has suppressed the fact that anticipatory bail application of the petitioner under section 438 of Cr.P.C. was dismissed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court comprising of Hon'ble Shri Justice Anand Pathak vide order dated 12/12/2023 (Annexure A/2) passed in M.Cr.C. No.
53698/2023 bearing crime No. 594/2023.

It is further submitted that the petition filed by this petitioner under section 482 of Cr.P.C bearing M.Cr.C. No. 45451/2023 for quashing of the FIR was also dismissed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court comprising of Hon'ble Shri Justice Anand Pathak vide order dated 26/10/2023.
Thereafter, petitioner with a malafide intention changed the crime number as 954/2023 and had filed the bail application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. before this Court.

Since, it was a different crime number mentioned in the bail application under section 439 of Cr.P.C., therefore, the said bail application was not listed by the registry before the co-ordinate Bench of this Court comprising of Hon'ble Shri Justice Anand Pathak, but the same was listed before this Court.

Under these circumstances, bail order dated 01/02/2024 has been obtained by the petitioner by suppressing the fact with respect to mentioning of wrong crime number i.e.
954/2023 in the bail application under section 439 of Cr.P.C., therefore, order dated 01/02/2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No. 2260/2024 deserves to be recalled and the instant petition is liable to be dismissed.
Heard and perused the record and also perused the record of M.Cr.C. No. 2260/2024.

Perusal of the record of M.Cr.C. No. 2260/2024 reveals that in the order of the learned trial court dated 30/12/2023 passed in bail application No. 1182/2023, crime number is mentioned as 954/2023, therefore, the petitioner has mentioned the same crime number in the bail application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed before this Court.

In view of above, the contentions of learned counsel for the complainant / respondent is not acceptable that crime number 954/2023 was wrongly mentioned by the petitioner in the bail application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed before this Court with malafide intention.

However, in the light of the fact that if correct crime number was mentioned i.e crime No. 594/2023 in the bail application bearing M.Cr.C. No. 2260/2024 under section 439 of Cr.P.C., the case would have been Raju Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174069582/
2 listed by the registry before the co-ordinate Bench of this Court comprising of Hon'ble Shri Justice Anand Pathak since the co-ordinate bench has already decided the anticipatory bail application of the petitioner bearing crime No. 594/2023 under section 438 of Cr.P.C.

Accordingly, this petition is dismissed and the order dated 01/02/2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.
2260/2024 is hereby recalled.
Petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned trial court forthwith.
The petitioner is at liberty to file appropriate application for correction of crime number before the learned trial court.
A copy of this order be sent to the learned trial court for information.
